title: cotula sessilis
intro: Cotula sessilis, commonly known as Marsh Daisy or Button Daisy, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, treat wounds and infections, and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents present in Cotula sessilis include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
